threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: It came from the dwarf Bral and also marks the Dwarven mine. The ghost of Bral's brother Grimny says Bral probably hid the dwarves' hoard in the Dragon's Lair.

threads.label: The black dragon
threads.text: Eric the Reeve pays a thousand gold for its body. The witch Vivian says enough faun wine would knock it out, so you could drive Sir Brandon's sword through its mouth.

threads.label: Your new companions
threads.text: Lady Hilda and the wizard Malzazarik joined you. You owe them pay, pledged against Cedric's promissory note.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned
threads.text: He travels with you as a hired scout for a hundred gold. He carries tools such as a crowbar.

threads.label: The missing shipments
threads.text: Cedric and Warwick the smith described their lost supplies, and Warwick pointed you to a mine in the north. It's still unknown what is stopping shipments into Brandonsford, including Bentley's overdue restock.

threads.label: Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve
threads.text: He challenged the Reeve to a duel at dawn, and it is still to be fought.

threads.label: Shamus the mule
threads.text: Farmer Gill asked a hundred gold for him and says he may go lower. He won't lower it until his boys return, since he can't work without them or a mule.

threads.label: Warwick's mithril shirt
threads.text: Wayman wears it on loan. It halves damage from magic weapons and spells. Warwick holds Sir Phidipaldi's armor and lyre as collateral, and you owe him metal from the Dwarven mine.

threads.label: Squints the halfling
threads.text: He joined you as Trout's junior assistant. Trout owes him a pick from the Halfling Corps' first treasure after the elite members, and until then he pays his own way.

threads.label: Dr. Uriah's penance
threads.text: He owes Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a ten gold donation for its upkeep.

threads.label: The hidden fairies
threads.text: They were once hidden, and no one yet knows why they now come out more often.

threads.label: The giant in the cyclopean cottage
threads.text: This slow, man-eating giant north of Brandonsford is now awake. He chased you until he tired.

threads.label: The undead swordsman of the Barrow Mound
threads.text: Drop Dead Ned's wasp broke apart Sir Alfred, the undead knight. You left him incapacitated but not destroyed.

threads.label: The Free Goblin Society
threads.text: Wayman persuaded the goblins to wall off the mound's upper rooms and destroy its church. You later trailed drunk goblins to King Hogboon's temple castle.

threads.label: The barrow robes
threads.text: Dr. Uriah kept them through a deal with Brother Dirk, but they are not magical. He promised to return them to the church once the dragon is defeated.

threads.label: The voice in the tomb
threads.text: No one knows whose female voice asked, "What makes a true knight?"

threads.label: Cedric's promissory note
threads.text: At Sir Phidipaldi's insistence, Cedric signed it for your barrow treasure. Dr. Uriah tallies it at nine hundred seventy-five gold, payable once the caravans flow again.

threads.label: Dunk's dwarven ring
threads.text: He took this magic ring from a dead dwarf in the cave-in, and wearing it, he met Grimny's ghost.

threads.label: Grimny's murder
threads.text: His ghost believes greedy Bral murdered him, but how he died is still unknown. Dunk suspects there is no dragon at all, only Bral pretending.

closing: You stand at the caved-in entrance of the Dwarven mine, beside the burnt cabin at the base of the hill, with Malzazarik the Magnificent and Lady Hilda. The collapse looks natural, and it can be dug through.
